🌟 authpass | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, secure, and accessible password management solution across all major platforms, leveraging the KeePass KDBX format.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform compatibility (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web) • KeePass 2.x (KDBX 3 and KDBX 4) database support • Secure password management • Open-source development • Flutter framework based
📖 Summary: AuthPass is an open-source, cross-platform password manager built with Flutter. It offers compatibility with KeePass 2.x (KDBX 3 and KDBX 4) databases, allowing users to securely store and manage their credentials across various devices including mobile (iOS, Android) and desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux), as well as a web interface.
